notes: Original-only fresh blind validation. Source is the supplied scanned published article, pp. 185–190, with a separate scanned-copy notice; title/authors verified on rendered PDF page 1. Rendered PDF pages 2–3 verify the target method, sample and result. Requested OR is not printed for this test, and no effect-size conversion was performed; es.value and metric remain null while the printed chi-square is retained in test_statistic. Canonical text renders chi-square as ␹2, equals as ⫽, and less-than as ⬍; the rendered page clearly shows χ², =, and <. Quotes preserve the exact canonical glyphs and line break; the test_statistic field describes their visually verified meaning. Replication and reported_success are unassigned placeholders.
